language.title: Display language
language.description: Toolset UI language. Use auto to follow OpenIDEA's default UI language.

defaultIndent.title: Default indentation
defaultIndent.description: Indentation used when formatting JSON, XML, SQL, HTML, CSS, and generated code.

defaultTimezone.title: Default timezone
defaultTimezone.description: IANA timezone name used by Timestamp and Cron tools (e.g. Asia/Shanghai, UTC).

maxHistoryItems.title: Recent tools / history limit
maxHistoryItems.description: Maximum number of recent tools and per-tool history entries kept in storage.

pomodoroFocusMinutes.title: Pomodoro focus duration (minutes)
pomodoroFocusMinutes.description: Length of each focus session in minutes.

pomodoroBreakMinutes.title: Pomodoro short break (minutes)
pomodoroBreakMinutes.description: Length of each short break in minutes.

pomodoroLongBreakMinutes.title: Pomodoro long break (minutes)
pomodoroLongBreakMinutes.description: Length of a long break after 4 focus sessions.

restoreLastTabs.title: Restore open tool tabs
restoreLastTabs.description: Reopen the last workspace tabs when Toolset starts.
